title: Float Space mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from Float Space's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod. "none": only where a layout or another mod puts it.

focusable.description: Lets pane.go give a shown copy the keyboard.

settings.description: Your changes. A setting left out uses its default.

width.title: Default width
width.description: Width of the Normal size, which a first window opens at and Reset goes back to, as a share of Herdr's window. A size you already chose is kept.

height.title: Default height
height.description: Height of the Normal size, which a first window opens at and Reset goes back to, as a share of Herdr's window. A size you already chose is kept.

blocked.title: Needs you
blocked.description: Sound and notification when an agent in a Float Space terminal needs you.

done.title: Finished
done.description: Sound and notification when an agent in a Float Space terminal finishes while you aren't looking at it. Its tab still gets a dot.
